ns2:course.label: Jewelry/Metals II
ns2:course.description: Additional experience and experimentation in designing and executing jewelry and related objects through fabrication, refinement of surface embellishment, joining, and finishing skills; further exploration of metal as a medium of personal aesthetic expression. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTS 230.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTS 230.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art History or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
